title: Scenarios
intro: The stories a game is started from. A scenario is a draft until it is published.
deleteScenarioHint: Only a scenario no game was started from can be deleted, with its own definitions.
catalogueHint: The scenario's own definitions: added to the world's, or replacing the world's one of the same reference.

form.title: Title
form.synopsisHint: In English, shown to the players in the New game catalogue.
form.glossaryHint: Proper names of this story that are no person nor place of the game, added to the world's.
form.characterHint: The character every game of this scenario is played with, written as JSON: name, the seven characteristics (STR, CON, SIZ, INT, POW, DEX, CHA, from 3 to 21), skills in percent and resources by reference, and items (definition, descriptor, quantity, equipped). Hit points derive from CON and SIZ.
form.startHint: Picked from the named places of the world and the scenario, and from this scenario's chapters and quests.
form.startTimeHint: When the story opens, on its first day. The players only ever see the period of the day.
form.startDateHint: In the Gregorian calendar, if the story has one. Leave it empty for a story with no date: the game then counts its days.
form.questSummaryHint: In English, for the model: what the character has to do.

publication.title: Publication
publication.draft: Draft: only game masters see it, to try it out.
publication.published: Published: players may start a game from it. Edits reach new turns at once.

issues.missing_english_label: A name in English is missing.
issues.characteristic_out_of_range: {{reference}} must be a whole number from 3 to 21 (INT and SIZ from 8).
issues.invalid_dice: “{{reference}}” is no dice expression such as 1D6+1.
issues.unknown_skill: “{{reference}}” is no skill of this world.
issues.unknown_resource: “{{reference}}” is no resource of this world.
issues.unknown_location: “{{reference}}” is no named place of this world.
issues.unknown_item: “{{reference}}” is no item of this world.
issues.unknown_holder: “{{reference}}” is no named person or place of this world.
issues.unknown_chapter: “{{reference}}” is no chapter of this scenario.
issues.unknown_quest: “{{reference}}” is no quest of this scenario.
issues.no_action_type: The world has no category of action: no action could be rolled.
issues.missing_generic_npc: No generic person to improvise passers-by from.
issues.missing_location_archetype: No place archetype to improvise places from.
issues.missing_generic_item: No generic item to improvise objects from.
issues.missing_initial_state: The story has no starting place yet.
issues.not_stackable: “{{reference}}” is not stackable: one copy only.
issues.item_held_elsewhere: “{{reference}}” is unique and already held by someone else when the game starts.
issues.exit_to_itself: A place cannot lead to itself.
issues.duplicate_passage: Two passages join the same places: declare it once, on one side.
issues.invalid_duration: “{{reference}}” is no duration of a passage: moment, minutes, hour or hours.
issues.entrance_without_exits: “{{reference}}” is an entrance, but has no exit: it is part of no network.
issues.unreachable_network: Nothing leads into the network of “{{reference}}”: mark one of its places as an entrance, or start the story in it.
issues.start_contains_network: “{{reference}}” only contains a network: start the story in one of its places.
